raw_content:
Cap rate survey: office and logistics, 2026

Average cap rates for US logistics properties held at 5.6% in 2026. Suburban office cap rates widened to 8.1% in 2026, and waterfront office assets traded at a 7.2% cap rate in 2026.

The survey covers appraisals and closed trades across twenty metropolitan areas.

This fictional survey was prepared for a software demonstration.
